title: Sliding uPVC Windows
whatIsIt: Sashes that glide horizontally on rollers within the frame, rather than swinging open — nothing projects into the room or outside.
whyChooseIt: Doesn't need clearance to open, so it works in tight balconies and corridors, and the wide track supports larger window sizes with smooth, low-effort operation.

benefits.title: Space saving
benefits.description: No swing radius needed — ideal where furniture or walkways sit close to the window.

benefits.title: Smooth, easy operation
benefits.description: SS 304 friction stays and co-extruded gaskets keep the sash gliding smoothly for years.

benefits.title: Up to 66% opening
benefits.description: Wide ventilation area for a window style that stays flush and unobtrusive.

designOptions: 2-track or 3-track configurations with multiple shutter counts depending on opening width.

series.description: Offers up to 66% opening with a space-saving design that minimises air leakage, with reinforcement that supports larger window sizes.
Designed for constrained spaces, balancing simplicity with visual uniformity across the rest of the product line.
